'''Warren Sedoru''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who lived during the [[Great Galactic War]], the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] born several decades before [[3681 BBY]], the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Warren Sedoru was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and quickly became one of the most acclaimed [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. When the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] reclaimed their holy world in the [[Battle of Korriban|Battle]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and began the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Sedoru was one of the first Jedi to lead counterattacks against Imperial forces. He scored several early victories against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], fighting in [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Great Galactic War)|dozens]] of [[Battle of Alderaan|battles]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] on worlds such as [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] and [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], but was critically injured during many of these conflicts.

While he survived without [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] or prosthetics, Sedoru's connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] began to diminish, and when the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] ended the war in [[3653 BBY]] he became dedicated to peace. Giving up the rank of Jedi Knight, he became a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] to the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tol Braga]].

[[File:Sedoru.png|thumb|left|150px|Warren Sedoru before turning to the Dark side]]
In the early days of the [[Galactic War]], Sedoru was approached by his former Master for a new mission: the capture and redemption of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] himself. Braga also recruited the [[Hero of Tython]], the Jedi Knight responsible for ending the [[Desolator crisis]] and the defeat of [[Darth Angral]], and the Hero's former apprentice [[Kira Carsen]] to join the [[Jedi strike team (capture of the Sith Emperor)|strike team]] he was forming.

Sedoru was sent to [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] to obtain a cloaking device, possibly created by the [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] or the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]], the same technology used to hide the Emperor's fortress. But the device was located in the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]], now an Imperial stronghold, so they'd require the aid of the local resistance. Eventually, the Hero was able to obtain the cloaking device, albeit forced to trade the Empire's data on cloaked weapons to a few hostile resistance fighters for it.

Eventually, Braga's team was assembled on Tython to begin their mission. However, the Jedi Council asked to speak with them, explaining that their former team member, [[Jomar Chul]], just had a vision of the Hero falling to the dark side. Though Chul and [[Jaric Kaedan]] believed the mission to be too risky to allow the Hero to accompany them, Grand Master [[Satele Shan]] and Master [[Bela Kiwiiks]] expressed confidence in the Hero's loyalty.

The strike departed for [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] and infiltrated the Emperor's fortress. But upon confronting the Emperor, he used his dark powers to convert the entire strike team to the dark side.

Warren would later attack and board the Republic flagship [[Valiant (Valor-class)|''Valiant'']] along with a large number of Sith in an attempt to kill Admiral [[Dabrin]] on board after receiving the Republic codes. The Jedi Knight was able to confront Warren, and tried to convince to break away from the Emperor's power. Warren denied the Knight, and engaged the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]]. The Knight gained the upper hand. Badly injured from the fight, Warren tried to rise to his feet, but the Knight knocked him out. Dabrin then argued that Warren must be executed for fear of military secrets being leaked to the Empire but the Knight insisted he could be redeemed and told the Admiral to keep him imprisoned until the Jedi arrive to retrieve him. Warren mocked the Hero for their compassion before Dabrin knocked him out and stated that he will keep the fallen Jedi sedated as a precaution. Warren was sent back to Tython to be healed and redeemed.

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|My strengths lie in observation, subtlety and negotiation. Not exactly welcome talents on the battlefield.|Warren Sedoru|<ref name="Lives in the Balance" />}}
Warren was among the strongest and most resolute Jedi of his time.<ref name="SWTORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Warren Sedoru was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He first appears in the Jedi Knight class story mission "Lives in the Balance," and features heavily throughout the Act II storyline on Balmorra.
